shots.spot: The Silo Hotel, your room's pillowed window bay

shots.what: Waterline-level frame: glass pool edge, harbour cranes, Table Mountain beyond, with the Nov 'tablecloth' cloud if the southeaster blows.
shots.why: Shows the working harbour and the mountain together, which few rooftop shots manage; the cloud makes it November-specific.
shots.when: Late afternoon 16:30-18:00 (rooftop closes around sunset, check). Sunset ~19:15.

shots.spot: Zeitz MOCAA atrium via the hotel's private entrance

shots.spot: V&A Hotel, Table Mountain-view room / Alfred Basin quay

shots.avoid: A static clear-sky Table Mountain postcard.

shots.what: Horse riders silhouetted on the wet sand with Chapman's Peak's cliff road behind.
